note: Unmasked Fugle quotes (#834; docs/DATA_SOURCES.md 盤中報價): the one copy of the patterns tools/ops/quote_guard.py and tools/ops/agent_guard.cjs both read. Each regex is written so Python re and JavaScript RegExp read it the same: [0-9] rather than \d, no named groups, fixed-width lookbehind only. templates: the pieces of backend/worker/intraday.py TEMPLATES that carry a Fugle value once filled in, keyed by the TEMPLATES key or the field ({open}); a masked value (<價>, <時間>) holds no digit and passes, and so do the rule levels (觸及規則進場價 X, 停損 X, 目標一 X), which are ours, a count (無成交 N, 成交 N 股／張／筆) and a daily price written 開盤價 X. fields: the fields of Fugle's answer backend/worker/fugle.py reads, as JSON keys, Python keywords or key=value (field_head after the name); the value counts when it is a number (scalar) or a [..], {..} or (..) with any digit inside (balanced across lines, quotes skipped; one that never closes ends at its line's end). repr: a fugle.Quote as Python prints it, from open to its closing parenthesis on the line: any key=number or a datetime with a number. record: a JSON line, bare or after --- <word>; message: its text (a --- message record, or a line of the day's jsonl) is checked with the templates, \u escapes decoded, and a --- message line that is no record hits too; levels: the per-stock entries of its levels object whose high, low or last is a number (PR #812 _record_levels); the rule levels inside each entry's own levels list pass. backend/tests/test_quote_guard.py binds templates to TEMPLATES.
